fail_closed_modifications.change: Fallback calculate_source_allowed_actions raises RuntimeError('Source action policy is unavailable') instead of granting permissive actions.
validate_institutional_memory_json raises RuntimeError('jsonschema is required for institutional memory validation') instead of returning empty error list.
validate_persona_memory_json raises RuntimeError('jsonschema is required for persona memory validation') instead of returning empty error list.
JSON schema validation is mandatory when schema is configured; governed identity checks fail closed when binding/runtime/capital_pool is missing or mismatched.
_validate_event rejects with 'Telemetry schema is unavailable' when schema_path is configured but the telemetry or trade-journal schema failed to load.

validate_event returns False when jsonschema is unavailable or the schema is invalid instead of True; the optional import stays so the lineage-read image, which imports the package without jsonschema, still starts.
jsonschema import and Draft7Validator are mandatory; metadata schema validation can no longer be skipped.

shared_module_locks_check.method: For every Dockerfile that installs a dependencies/locks file, ast-parse the module-level imports reachable from its ENTRYPOINT/CMD (through package __init__ files, relative imports and sys.path-inserted repo directories; function-level, TYPE_CHECKING and ImportError-guarded imports are optional) and require every third-party import to be pinned in that lock. Nested packages with their own requirements or Dockerfile are followed like any other module.
shared_module_locks_check.known_gaps: none: KNOWN_GAPS and --fix were removed (--fix appended bare ranges to hash-locked files and would break --require-hashes)
shared_module_locks_check.gap_found_and_fixed: services-learning-imitation.txt lacked jsonschema although services/research/imitation/preference_models.py imports it at module level; services/learning/imitation/requirements.txt now lists jsonschema and the lock was recompiled with uv (adds jsonschema, jsonschema-specifications, referencing, rpds-py).
shared_module_locks_check.lineage_read_simulation: With services/telemetry/__init__.py eagerly importing ingest_svc the check fails on services-lineage-read.txt missing jsonschema; the lazy __getattr__ tree passes. Both cases are unit tests and were also run against the real tree.

validation_summary.bff_data_sources_contract_tests: test_bff_management_data_sources_contract.py passed (6 tests); the fallback test fails when the permissive fallback is restored
validation_summary.telemetry: test_infrastructure_health_ingest.py 54 passed; smoke_test_ingest.py passed; two test_lineage_write_path.py full-stack cases fail identically without this change

corrections_to_original_evidence.import_check_coverage: The original claim of tracking all 64 compose services covered only the 9 services whose Dockerfile matched a stage-0 matrix build target; the matrix compose_services mirror is removed and scripts/ci_stage0.py now derives every service from docker compose config.
corrections_to_original_evidence.lock_check_coverage: The original check inspected only services/loop-control by substring match, skipped packages that ship their own Dockerfile, and a first rewrite hid 20 gaps in KNOWN_GAPS (one of which masked the lineage-read telemetry regression). It now checks the module-level imports each image entrypoint actually reaches against that image's lock, with no known-gap list.
corrections_to_original_evidence.datasources_test: The original test exec'd a copy of the fallback source; it now re-imports the real module with the policy modules unavailable and was verified to fail when the permissive fallback is restored.
corrections_to_original_evidence.telemetry_ingest_missing_schema: Out of scope here and the earlier claim is withdrawn. TelemetryIngestService._validate_event rejects only when a schema_path is configured but fails to load, but services/telemetry/main.py (~587) passes schema_path=None when the file is missing, so the deployed service still accepts events without a schema. Fixing main.py is split into a separate task.

validators_left_as_is.reason: Safe to leave: it only builds draft signal_snapshot registry entries after the artifact_type, draft state, sha256 checksum and lineage checks above it have already passed, and registry admission re-validates the schema. Its image is hash-locked (dependencies/locks/services-research-statsmodels.txt) without jsonschema, is not a compose service, and a lock recompile needs uv with network access.

image_import_smoke.how: python3 scripts/ci_stage0.py import-smoke --image-id <id>: docker build, then docker run --entrypoint python with the compose environment (and the compose postgres service for images that open stores at import) importing the effective ENTRYPOINT+CMD or compose command; uvicorn app attributes are checked, scripts run under runpy with a non-__main__ name so dataclasses resolve, shell commands get bash -n.
image_import_smoke.triggers: pull_request to dev (images whose Dockerfile, named lock/requirements, Python source, compose file, .dockerignore or compose-command script changed), schedule 17 3 * * *, workflow_dispatch (all images), and the promote-head dispatch (all images); docker-compose.control.yml images (feedback) are included
image_import_smoke.full_run_import_jobs: workflow_dispatch full sweep: all 64 successful jobs include every Import smoke image job; the 5 failures are the pre-existing per-target jobs below, none is an import smoke job
image_import_smoke.pull_request_run: https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/actions/runs/37465816762 (pull_request to dev, same head: 42 jobs success, 6 skipped, 0 failed; baseline + selected import smoke jobs, per-target verify/build skipped by design)

stage0_zero_job_runs.finding: The 99 earlier zero-job Stage 0 runs were bot-triggered pull_request runs on promote/* heads: runs created for a PR opened with GITHUB_TOKEN do not start workflows. It was not a workflow file error (actionlint is clean).
stage0_zero_job_runs.fix: publish_promote.dispatch_promote_ci now also dispatches stage-0-ci.yml on the promote ref with expected_head_sha/promote_pr_number (validated in the import-smoke-plan job), best-effort so a promote ref predating the inputs cannot block promotion. The stage-0 dispatch inputs approval_race_id/two_man_race_id are no longer required.

residual_stage0_failures_not_in_scope: Verify changed services (persona, bff, cron, governance-api) and Docker build dry run (research-base) were long broken (missing bff/read_store.py in py_compile, missing pytest/pydantic, stale smoke tests that need PYTHONPATH or a terminal execution receipt, research-base build context). Pull requests to dev and promote dispatches therefore run only the baseline and the import smoke; those per-target jobs keep running for other base branches and are left to a follow-up task. The full-sweep dispatch and the nightly schedule still run them and are red on exactly: Verify changed services (bff, persona, governance-api, cron) and Docker build dry run (research-base).
